metaDescription: Who runs {brand}, what is on the board, how an order travels from payment to your account, and how your keys are kept.

hero.title: About {brand}
hero.lead: A store for game keys, gift cards and subscriptions across every major platform, with the platform and region shown before you pay.

range.title: What’s on the board
range.body: {brand} serves customers in the {countries}. You buy every key from us, at the price shown. Prices can be shown in {currencies}.

pay.label: Payment
pay.body: You pay by card ({cardMethods}) on the payment provider’s hosted page. We receive the confirmation, never your card number.

deliver.label: Delivery
deliver.body: Once payment is confirmed, the key is issued to Account → Keys, {usual}. We email you when it is there.

redeem.label: Redeem
redeem.body: You reveal the key when you’re ready and enter it on the platform named on the product page.

keeping.title: How we keep your keys
keeping.body: Keys are stored encrypted and shown only to you, when you choose Reveal. If a key doesn’t work, tell us within {claimDays} days of delivery: we replace it, or refund it if no replacement is available. You can cancel for free until a key is issued; after that, the {days}-day right to cancel ends for that key.
keeping.gate: What passes through us, and what never does

items.marketplace: Keys from other customers. {brand} is a store, not a marketplace: every key comes from us.
items.cases: Mystery keys, loot boxes or anything with a random outcome.
items.accounts: Game or platform accounts. We never ask for your platform password.
items.other: Keys that need a VPN, or keys for regions we don’t serve.
